exposure: Transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) status
cohort: The study included 199 neonates (123 with Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn and 76 healthy controls) admitted to a tertiary care hospital between 2022 and 2025.
finding: Elevated inflammatory indices were observed in neonates with Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn, particularly in term infants and those delivered vaginally, suggesting a potential role for systemic inflammation in TTN pathophysiology.
mod_finding: Cesarean births showed higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NL-r) and systemic immune-inflammation index (SII-i) than vaginal deliveries.
cross-section timing: Within the first two hours of life.
gest_age: Late preterm, early-term, and full-term neonates.
